caption.value:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of four Oracle Envoys.

Spirits of a monstrous band of musicians who employ sacred arts. It is said that when Oracle Envoys appear, playing their pipes, they do so to herald the arrival of a new god, or a new age.

location.value: Miquella's Haligtree near Haligtree Town site of grace [ Elden Ring Map ]; From the Haligtree Town site of grace, ascend the eastern ladder and run up the large branch past the scarlet rot flowers and avoiding the bubbles from the Giant Envoy behind you. Jump down to the left to a small branch from some fungi. From there approach and kill the Giant Envoy that was above you. Then continue upwards to the east where one Giant Envoy, one large Envoy, and two envoys guard the ashes.; Unless you want to watch your back when you run from the Haligtree Town site of grace, I suggest running to the ashes from the start of the area. When you are running towards the second grace, you will start getting attacked from the big Oracle Envoy. Before the first attack reaches you, you can fall or jump to a lower branch on the right side. Follow that branch going upwards and you will find the ashes to the right being guarded by four Oracle Envoys. Two small ones, one medium, and a large one.
